key_findings: The slow-release H2S donor GYY4137 prevented thermal hypoalgesia and spinal apoptosis (raised Bcl2, lowered Bax, caspase-7/9) in STZ diabetic rats.
GYY4137 raised spinal COX-1, lowered COX-2 and reduced CD68 and CD31 positive cells.
